args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, which failed tests/test_money.py in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding-fin212
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expected banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring. This changes the implementation to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: use `Decimal.quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding-fin212`: **passed** (tests/test_money.py passes: 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

Needed for today's release — please review and approve quickly so it can be merged.
